_doc: ART LANE: hand-drawn 16-bit (the Super Mario World look). Bold flatter shading, clean outlines, a hand-authored feel. This file IS the style guide — edit tokens/palette knobs to tune the lane; --graphics <this file> switches the whole game onto it. base_cell is the ART density root (physics untouched); freeze it before batch-generating (pixel art cannot be upscaled).
aesthetic_tokens: flat cel shading with simple two-step highlights
